name: tartlet-cli-workspace
description: Public npm packages for Tartlet, a self-hosted Mac VM console

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tartlet/protocol && npm run build --workspace @tartlet/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tartlet/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @tartlet/protocol && npm run test --workspaces
